Approval.description: Approval entry for an invoice or purchase. An approval tracks whether an invoice or purchase has been approved or denied by a designated approver. The `target_type` field indicates whether the approval belongs to an invoice or a purchase, and the `target` field contains the corresponding invoice or purchase object.

target_type.description: The type of the approval target.

decided_at.description: Timestamp when the approval decision was made.

note.description: Note attached to the approval request.

deny_note.description: Note attached when denying the approval.

processed_by.description: User who approved or denied the approval request.

target.description: The invoice or purchase this approval belongs to.

Comment.description: Comment attached to a business entity.

CompanyRef.description: Minimal company reference used in nested resources.

Deal.description: Sales deal with status, value, ownership, and links.

DealRef.description: Minimal deal reference used in nested resources.

budget_relevant.description: Whether this expense affects budget calculations.

billable.description: Whether this expense can be billed to customer.

billed.description: Whether this expense has already been billed.

ExpenseBulkItemRequest.description: Single item payload accepted by project expense bulk endpoint.

revenue_category_id.description: Rejected with 422 when the revenue category only applies to tasks, unless the stored value is unchanged.

Invoice.description: Base invoice representation returned in invoice list endpoints.

reversed.description: Whether this invoice has been reversed.

reversal_invoice_id.description: Id of the reversal invoice, if any.

reversal.description: Whether this invoice itself is a reversal invoice.

reversed_invoice_id.description: Id of the invoice that was reversed by this one.

recipient_address.description: Recipient address printed on the invoice.

cash_discount_days.description: Number of days cash discount is valid.

custom_properties.description: Custom field values keyed by custom field name.

letter_paper_id.description: Letter paper ID used for this invoice. Available letter papers can be fetched via `GET /api/v1/letter_papers`.

without_letter_paper.description: Whether the invoice is set to be printed without letter paper (white). When `true`, `letter_paper_id` will be `null`.

file_url.description: Download URL to the invoice file. URL is temporary and can change.

debt_collection_procedure.description: Debt collection procedure linked to this invoice, if any.

footer.description: Footer text used in invoice document.

items.description: Invoice line items in display order.

net_total.description: Net total amount for this line.

paid_total_in_account_currency.description: Amount paid converted to the account currency.

OfferCustomerApproval.description: Customer approval state and public URLs for an offer.

PlannedPurchase.description: Planned purchase definition for recurring or one-time purchases. A planned purchase defines a budget for purchases with a specific supplier, purchase budget, and user. It can be one-time or recurring (weekly, monthly, etc.).

date.description: Start date of the planned purchase.

active.description: Whether the planned purchase is active.

finish_date.description: End date of the planned purchase (for recurring planned purchases).

variant.description: Planned purchase variant type (`once` for one-time planned purchases, `recurring` for recurring planned purchases).

net_total.description: Net total amount in the planned purchase currency.

exhausted.description: Amount already spent from planned purchase.

purchases.description: Linked purchases created from this planned purchase.

custom_properties.description: Custom property values for the planned purchase.

create_on_recur.description: Whether to automatically create purchases on recurrence.

PlanningEntry.description: Planning entry assigned to a user and optionally linked to project/deal/task.

retainer.description: Whether the project is a retainer project.

start_date.description: Project start date in ISO-8601 date format.

finish_date.description: Project finish date in ISO-8601 date format.

billing_variant.description: How rates are applied: - `project`: one project rate - `task`: per task rate - `user`: per assigned user rate

billing_email_cc.description: Default CC recipient email(s) for billing.

setting_include_time_report.description: If true, include time report on generated billing documents.

hourly_rate.description: Effective hourly rate according to billing variant.
